subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: Knee pain in both knees for approximately six months.
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 32 years old and female. I'm here because of this knee pain I've been having for about six months now. It's in both knees and it's been really affecting my ability to run, which I used to love doing. Doctor: Could you please describe the nature of the knee pain? Is it sharp, dull, aching, or burning? Does it worsen with certain activities or at specific times of the day? Patient: It's more of a deep achy pain, like right behind my kneecaps. It really hurts when I stand up from sitting for a while or when I go up and down the stairs. It's been especially tough because I used to run a lot, but now I can barely do half a mile without pain. Doctor: Have you experienced any swelling, redness, or warmth in your knees? Have you had any recent injuries or changes in activity levels? Patient: No, I haven't noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth in my knees. I don't remember any recent injuries, but I have been dealing with this pain for about six months now. I used to run a lot, but now it's really hard to even do a half mile without pain. Doctor: Have you experienced any morning stiffness in your knees, and if so, how long does it last? Have you noticed any clicking, locking, or instability in your knees? Patient: No, I haven't had any morning stiffness in my knees. And I don't really notice any clicking, locking, or instability in my knees when I move them. It's just that deep ache, especially when I stand up or go up and down stairs. Doctor: Have you experienced any other joint pains or symptoms in other parts of your body, such as your hips, ankles, or fingers, over the past six months? Patient: No, I haven't had any other joint pains or symptoms
